title: Move zeros to the end, keeping order
summary: Push every empty slot on a bookshelf to the right while the books keep their order, without a second shelf.
goal: Move every empty slot to the end while books keep their order

examples.label: Two gaps
examples.explanation: Books 1, 3, 12 keep their order; both gaps move right.

examples.label: Already tidy
examples.explanation: The gap is already at the end.

ladder.name: Bubble each gap right
ladder.idea: Whenever a gap sits left of a book, swap them, and repeat until no gap is left of a book.

ladder.name: Copy onto a second shelf
ladder.idea: Copy the books in order onto an empty shelf, then fill the rest with gaps.
ladder.insight: The books' final order is just their current order with gaps removed, so one pass that copies books is enough.

ladder.name: Read and write pointers
ladder.idea: One pointer reads every slot; another marks where the tidy part ends. Each book read is swapped to the write pointer.
ladder.insight: The second shelf is only needed because we fear overwriting books. Writing never runs ahead of reading, so the same shelf can be both.

transfer.problem: A list of exam scores contains −1 for absent students. Move all the −1 entries to the end without changing the order of real scores, in place.
transfer.explanation: Same shape: a read pointer scans every entry and a write pointer marks where kept entries go.

selfCheck: Keeps the books in their original order.
Works in place, without a second list.
Leaves all gaps at the end.
Handles a shelf with no gaps and a shelf of only gaps.
